kids: Ride the hayride through the Christmas forest
Decorate a cookie and make a craft
site: American Legion Post 78, 6025 Spikes Way, Milton
about: American Legion Post 78 calls this its fifth annual S'mores with Santa and invites the whole Milton community to the North Pole it builds on its grounds.
The hayride winds through wooded grounds lit by inflatable Christmas decorations, so the lights are part of the ride rather than a separate stop.
Hands-on stations include cookie decorating and a Christmas craft, and Santa is on site for pictures.
Food and drink on the post's list are hot cider, hot chocolate, popcorn and hot dogs, with s'mores made around the fire.
Raffle baskets and a 50/50 raffle run by donation, while entry itself costs nothing.
The post says the evening is for all ages and names kids, parents, grandparents, veterans, friends and neighbors as welcome guests.
Navarre Beach tourism, which lists the event on its calendar, shows the evening as Friday, December 4, 5:30 to 7:30 PM at 6025 Spikes Way.
faq: When is S'mores with Santa in Milton?
Friday, December 4, from 5:30 to 7:30 PM.
Where is it held?
American Legion Post 78, 6025 Spikes Way, Milton, Florida.
Does it cost anything?
No. The post says the event is free and open to the community. Raffle baskets and a 50/50 raffle are available by donation.
Can we get pictures with Santa?
Yes. Pictures with Santa are on the post's list of activities.
What activities are there for kids?
Hayrides, cookie decorating, a Christmas craft, s'mores around the fire and lighted inflatable displays.
What food and drinks are served?
Hot cider, hot chocolate, popcorn and hot dogs are listed, along with s'mores.
Is it for all ages?
Yes. The post says it is fun for all ages and welcomes families, grandparents, veterans and neighbors.

kids: Visit Candy Cane Lane for free games and crafts
Get a free photo with Santa and the Grinch
about: The Navarre Beach Area Chamber of Commerce calls Christmas in the Park a tradition 32 years strong, and its 2026 edition is the 32nd annual.
Candy Cane Lane is the kids' area. The chamber invites local businesses and organizations to run free children's activities with games, crafts, decorating and prizes.
Mrs. Claus' Bakery offers complimentary baked goods and hot beverages, with coffee provided by Scooter's Coffee.

The chamber's stage schedule begins at 10:15 AM with the Navarre High School Chorus and includes Coastline Christian Academy, Holley Navarre Primary's Sandpiper Singers, the Fort Walton Beach Community Chorus and A Time To Dance at 3:30 PM.
The parade starts at 1 PM at the Navarre Library, runs south on Presidio Street, turns left on Esplanade Street and ends in the back parking lot of Centennial Bank.
After the parade, Santa, Mrs. Claus and the Grinch go to Navarre Park for free photos, with Centennial Bank and Century 21 listed as sponsors.
The Merry Market sells gifts from local artists, crafters and small retailers, and the chamber lists a Jingle Bell Run family fun run at 8 AM that starts at the Main Fire Station.
faq: When is Christmas in the Park in Navarre?
Saturday, December 5, 2026, from 10 AM to 4 PM.
Where is it held?
Navarre Park, 8513 Navarre Parkway, Navarre, Florida.
Is it free?
Yes. The chamber lists the event as free and open to the public.
What time is the parade?
The Navarre Community Christmas Parade rolls at 1 PM from the Navarre Library.
Are there free photos with Santa?
Yes. Santa, Mrs. Claus and the Grinch pose for free photos at Navarre Park after the parade.
What is Candy Cane Lane?
A kids' area of booths run by local businesses and groups with free games, crafts, decorating and prizes.
Is there food?
Mrs. Claus' Bakery gives out free baked goods and hot beverages, and a limited number of food and beverage vendors are planned.
